description: Stage 3.5 register row P1: per-state, per-anchor baseline of cumulative layout shift for each loading-to-content transition (the navigation, and one a preparation starts, kept apart), long tasks of the state's first operator interaction where it declares one, and the resolved font. A baseline, not a budget: X3 sets budgets and their tolerance from it. Tier B and C values are diagnostic only.
note: Both runs were made on the working tree committed unchanged as implementationHead; runBaseGitHead is the git HEAD the harness read at the time.

environment.browser: Chromium headless via CDP (no npm dependency)
environment.build: production build of src/web/mavi-web served with API fixtures

longTasks.source: longTasks — one lane, so another lane's work never contends with the measured interaction

statusVocabulary.cls: navigation transition: a number when measured; not-applicable when the state holds its loading presentation or shows none while loading; failed when one was still shown at settling, or the state was not reached; unsupported when the browser lacks the API
statusVocabulary.clsPreparation: a transition a preparation started, labelled with the interaction or "fixture preparation"; not-applicable when the preparation started no loading presentation or there is none
statusVocabulary.longTasks: {count,maxMs,totalMs,excludedAsHarness,startsAt} for a declared operator interaction, from the action to the page going quiet; not-applicable when the state declares none (a rendered state, or a fixture preparation)
statusVocabulary.font: resolved platform font face for the Context Bar and for content text when measured
